statements.text: Big Tech companies are building massive AI data centers that use enormous amounts of energy, driving up costs for everyone else while they rake in billions. They don’t even have to pay for the energy they use! [...] In Congress, I’ll hold Big Tech accountable. I’ll co-sponsor Bernie’s moratorium on new AI data centers, and make sure they pay for the energy they use.
statements.venue: Campaign website policy platform, 'An Economy for Everyone'

statements.text: We need a moratorium, It has to be global.
statements.venue: Town hall in Rockaway, reported by Insider NJ
Town hall in Rockaway, reported by Insider NJ (on AI)

statements.text: It’s clear that AI requires guardrails, that we need to slow down to better understand the impact that it could have, if you listen to the Anthrophic guys, on humanity, or just if you listen to everyone else, the quality and nature of our life,

We need to develop and expand our economy and new industries without the wholesale destruction of our environment, of our water systems, without fair energy usage, [...] The spill in Secaucus is a warning that we need to be more cautious.
statements.venue: Interview with NJ Spotlight News (on data centers)

statements.text: I’m not a luddite, okay, but I think that we need to have guardrails in the development of this technology.
statements.venue: Town hall in Chatham, reported by Morristown Green

statements.text: This is a pause. This isn’t a permanent stop,
statements.venue: Town hall in Chatham, reported by Morristown Green (on pausing new AI data-center development)

statements.text: They should be responsible for that cost, [...] It shouldn’t be transferred to ratepayers like ourselves.
